# Semantic HTTP 0.1 fixtures

Copied byte-for-byte from the Semantic HTTP specification, version 0.1
(commit `bcc338e` of `semantic-http-spec`):

- `http-schema-resource.schema.json` and `http-schema-resource.context.jsonld`
  from `source/_extra/0.1/`;
- `person.http-schema-resource.json` from `source/examples/`.
